questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Whether AI could replace doctors and nurses
How to protect your skin from the sun
Why fewer young people want to become doctors today
How nurses cared for Covid patients
questions.why: Neil says they'll discuss whether the AI revolution could replace human doctors and nurses.

questions.q: What does Sam doubt a robot could replace?
options: A doctor's ability to scan the body
A doctor's kind and caring way with patients
A doctor's knowledge of medicine
A doctor's long working hours
questions.why: Sam says he doubts a doctor's bedside manner could easily be replaced by a robot.

questions.q: How many people in the UK are treated for skin cancer each year?
options: About 500,000
About 2 million
About 21,000
Over 5 million
questions.why: Neil says every year in the UK over 5 million people are treated for skin cancer.

questions.q: According to Daniel Susskind, what could the Stanford system do?
options: Treat skin cancer without the need for surgery
Train new dermatologists
Spot cancerous freckles from photos
Stop freckles from appearing
questions.why: He says if you give it a photo of a freckle it can tell whether the freckle is cancerous.

questions.q: How accurate was the Stanford system?
options: As accurate as twenty-one leading dermatologists
Less accurate than one normal doctor at a local clinic
Right about half the time, like tossing a coin
Only accurate when it was used on people with pale skin
questions.why: Susskind says it was as accurate as twenty-one leading dermatologists.

questions.q: Why is Daniel Susskind not convinced that AI will replace doctors?
options: Because AI systems are still far too expensive for hospitals
Because most patients don't trust machines with their health
Because doctors can't fully explain how they make a diagnosis
Because the Stanford system made too many serious mistakes
questions.why: He says doctors struggle to explain how they diagnose, so it's hard to write instructions for a machine.

questions.q: According to Susskind, what do doctors say diagnosis needs?
options: Very expensive equipment
Creativity and judgement
Good reference books only
Many years of training in AI
questions.why: He says doctors would say it requires things like creativity and judgement.

questions.q: Why does Neil mention cooking rice?
options: To show how doctors relax
To explain a healthy diet
To compare AI with a recipe book
To give an example of a rule of thumb
questions.why: He says a good rule of thumb is two portions of water to one of rice.
